title: Perplexity Pro subscription
catchSummary: Pro answers are capped by unstated weekly/monthly numbers — 'average use' is the published unit — and the annual price never appears on official pages; only a $20/mo figure and an expired promo's '$200 value' line anchor the sticker.

price.now: $20/mo; annual billing exists but its price is not published on any official page fetched (the 'about $200/yr' figure rests on an expired India promo's dollar-value line, not a listed annual price)
price.renewal: 'Unless you cancel before the trial ends, your subscription will auto-renew at the standard rate for the plan you selected (monthly or annual).' Canceling ends service at the billing-cycle close; no pause option exists.

renewal: Monthly auto-renew at the standard rate unless canceled; annual subscriptions renew at the annual rate (figure not published). Account → Subscription → Manage Plan → Cancel Subscription; cancellations and downgrades take effect at the end of the billing cycle. Regional refund windows: EU/UK/Turkey 14 days; South Korea/Brazil 7 days; elsewhere monthly up to 24 hours, annual 72 hours (one official Max article says 48 — see evidence).
eligibility: Any individual with a supported payment method (App Store and Google Play also sell Pro)
Students: Education Pro at $10/mo with SheerID verification (half price, per the which-plan article)
Max at $200/mo or $2,000/yr — annual Max is web-only; Enterprise Pro from $40/seat/mo, edu/NPO $30/seat
Old promo routes are closed: the Airtel 12-month offer ended January 16 2026
restrictions: Pro Search: Free gets 3/day; Pro gets 'weekly limits (average use)' — no numeric cap published, and access 'may be limited during weeks of especially heavy usage'
Deep Research on Pro: 'monthly limits (average use)', no figure (Max's 50/month is stated by contrast)

Credits (plain-English: prepaid units for agentic 'Computer' tasks, 100 credits = $1): consumer Pro does not start with a fixed monthly pool — Pro shows only a one-time 4,000 bonus credit grant that expires after 30 days; Max carries 10,000/mo
The official model-list help article that the Pro page links is 404 — 'which models, exactly, today' has no single current canonical page
Agentic features (Labs, Comet agent work) may consume credits beyond the flat fee
verdict: Perplexity Pro is the answer-engine subscription: every frontier chat model in one tab plus search-native citations, at $20/mo with no hard published message counter — limits are 'average use' bands that tighten only in extreme weeks. The trade-offs are opacity (no numeric caps, a broken canonical model list) and thin agent economics (no standing monthly credit pool on consumer Pro). If your workflow is research-and-cite, it is the most natural $20; if it is long agentic runs, the credit math quietly pushes you toward Max or a metered API.
catches: 'Weekly limits (average use)' is the official wording — the cap exists but its number does not, and heavy weeks can throttle
The annual price is invisible on official pages: you see it only at checkout, and the $200/yr figure in third-party listings is promo-valuation lineage
One-time 4,000 bonus credits expire after 30 days — an onboarding grant, not an allowance
Refund windows are short and regional (24 h standard, 72 h annual) — and one official page disagrees with another on the annual window (72 vs 48 hours)
limits: Pro Search: numeric Pro cap not published (Free = 3/day)
Research queries: Pro = monthly 'average use' limit, number not published; Max = 50/month
Files: up to 50 uploads per project; PDFs/CSV/audio/video/images; higher upload rate limits
Media: 'enhanced image generation', 'limited access to video generation' — counts not published
Computer credits: no set monthly amount on consumer Pro; Max 10,000/mo
access_route: Subscribe from the Pro page or in the Perplexity app (web checkout shows the annual toggle price in-account); then track credit burn under Settings → Billing if you use agentic features.

claim_steps.step: Confirm $20/mo on the official pricing hub — the /pro page itself renders client-side, the hub page carries the static figures.
Read the Pro help article's limits wording ('weekly/monthly limits — average use') so the throttle behavior is unsurprising.
If you want annual, open checkout to read the actual yearly price — it appears nowhere on the public pages we fetched.
Students: verify via SheerID for Education Pro at $10/mo before paying full price.

economics_heading: What $20 buys when the caps are invisible
economics: Perplexity prices breadth (all frontier models + premium data sources PitchBook/Statista/S&P per the hub FAQ) rather than volume — against the $0.80/task illustrative reference, $20 is parity at ~25 heavy tasks, but no published cap tells you whether 30 tasks is allowed or throttled.
The student $10/mo Education Pro halves the entry price and is the only officially priced discount path we found for individuals.

Agent usage is the hidden variable: 100 credits = $1, Pro has no standing pool, so a week of agentic work is billed by credit purchase, not by the plan — Max's $200 with 10,000/mo credits is the pooled alternative (~$100 of credit face value monthly).
Annual prepay cannot be evaluated on price-per-month because the annual figure is not published — treat any '$200/yr' claim as unverified until checkout shows it.

evidence.point: $20/mo Pro, the Free/Pro/Max feature matrix, 4,000 one-time bonus credits, and premium data sources (PitchBook, Statista, S&P Capital IQ) were read from the official pricing hub's server-rendered text via browser-UA fetch (the automated fetcher is 403-blocked site-wide).

Limits wording ('Pro Search: weekly limits (average use)', 'Research Queries: monthly limits (average use)', Free '3/day', 50 files/project), the model examples (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4, Sonar), and auto-renew/no-pause mechanics come from five official help-center articles dated Jul 16–Sep 2 2026.

Annual Pro price: the billing FAQ proves annual billing exists ('switching from annual to monthly'), but no fetched official page states its USD amount; the search snippet '$17/month billed annually' was not visible on the JS-shell /pro page and is treated as unconfirmed.
evidence.source: Billing FAQ + absence check across hub/pricing, 2026-09-07

evidence.point: Refund windows (14d EU/UK/TR, 7d KR/BR, 24h monthly, 72h annual) are from the Refunds article; the Max article states a 48-hour annual window — an unresolved internal conflict between two official pages both dated Jul 16 2026.

faq.q: What does Perplexity Pro cost as of the Sep 2026 snapshot?
faq.a: $20/month, read on the official pricing hub 2026-09-07. Annual billing exists but its price is not published on official pages — read the real figure at checkout before prepaying.

Officially numeric limits are not published: Pro Search carries 'weekly limits (average use)' (Free gets 3/day), Deep Research 'monthly limits (average use)' (Max gets 50/month). Throttling can tighten 'during weeks of especially heavy usage'.

faq.q: Do Pro credits roll over or reset?
faq.a: Consumer Pro has no standing monthly credit pool — the 4,000-credit grant is one-time and expires after 30 days. Credits (100 = $1) are prepaid units for agentic tasks; Max is the tier with a monthly 10,000-credit allowance.

Regionally: EU/UK/Turkey within 14 days, South Korea/Brazil within 7, elsewhere 24 hours for monthly and 72 hours for annual purchases (one official page says 48 for annual — the pages conflict). Canceled plans keep access until the cycle ends; there is no pause option.

faq.q: Is there a cheaper official route?
faq.a: Education Pro at $10/mo with SheerID verification. The Airtel India 12-month promo (valued at $200) ended January 16 2026 and is not a current path.
